data.one_liner: Integrates Google Vision REST API features for image analysis and OCR.
data.what_it_does: Allows developers to add Google Vision features including image labeling, face, logo, and landmark detection, optical character recognition (OCR), and explicit content detection into cross-platform applications.
use_when: You need to integrate Google Cloud Vision API features into a Dart or Flutter application.
You want built-in support for OCR, document text to markdown conversion, and face or label detection.
avoid_when: You require on-device machine learning models that do not depend on cloud connectivity or API keys.
You are looking for general image picking or cropping tools without cloud analysis.
strengths: Comprehensive coverage of Google Vision REST API features.
Includes retry utilities, input validation, and secure logging interceptors.
Supports multiple authentication methods including JWT and API keys.
weaknesses: Requires an active internet connection and a Google Cloud account with Vision API enabled.
May involve ongoing costs depending on Google Cloud Vision API usage pricing.
data.setup_notes: Requires obtaining a Google Cloud project, enabling the Cloud Vision API, and configuring an API key or service account JSON file.
